f3_program: collection("trees.growth_rates", "growth_rate", "trees", source("There are four growing trees"))
member("trees.growth_rates", "trees.first.growth.rate", source("The first tree grows 1 meter/day"))
member("trees.growth_rates", "trees.second.growth.rate", source("the second grows the same amount in half the time"))
member("trees.growth_rates", "trees.fourth.growth.rate", source("the fourth tree grows a meter more than the third each day"))
observe(at("trees.first.growth.rate", "current"), 1, "meter_per_day", source("The first tree grows 1 meter/day"))
same("trees.second.growth.amount", "trees.first.growth.amount", source("the second grows the same amount"))
quotient_relation("trees.second.growth.rate", "trees.second.growth.amount", "trees.second.growth.duration", source("the second grows the same amount in half the time"))
offset("trees.fourth.growth.rate", "trees.third.growth.rate", 1, "meter_per_day", source("the fourth tree grows a meter more than the third each day"))
assumptions: The second tree's comparison refers to the first tree.

f3_program: multiple("household.oranges.future_purchase.weekly_mass_kg", at("household.oranges.purchased.mass_kg", "current"), 2, source("buy twice as many oranges each week"))

rate_relation("household.oranges.future_purchase.total_mass_kg", "household.oranges.future_purchase.weekly_mass_kg", at("household.oranges.future_purchase.duration", "next_two_weeks"), source("for the next coming two weeks they'll have to buy twice as many oranges each week"))

add("next_two_weeks_purchases", "sofia_and_mother", at("household.oranges.purchased.mass_kg", "current"), "household.oranges.future_purchase.total_mass_kg", source("for the next coming two weeks they'll have to buy twice as many oranges each week"))
assumptions: Twice as many refers to the combined first-week purchase after the additional five kilograms.

f3_program: observe(at("bucky.video_game.cost", "current"), 60, "currency", source("a new video game, which costs $60"))
collection("bucky.sunday.catch.by_species", "fish_group", "bucky.sunday.catch", source("60% were trout, and the rest were blue-gill"))
partition("bucky.sunday.catch.by_species", at("bucky.sunday.catch.count", "sunday"), source("60% were trout, and the rest were blue-gill"))

product_relation(at("bucky.sunday.catch.trout.earnings", "sunday"), at("bucky.sunday.catch.trout.count", "sunday"), at("bucky.trout.earnings_per_fish", "current"), source("He can earn $5 from trout"))

add("sunday_trout_sale_earnings", "bucky", at("bucky.video_game_fund.amount", "current"), at("bucky.sunday.catch.trout.earnings", "sunday"), source("Bucky earns money each weekend catching and selling fish"))

add("sunday_blue_gill_sale_earnings", "bucky", at("bucky.video_game_fund.amount", "current"), at("bucky.sunday.catch.blue_gill.earnings", "sunday"), source("Bucky earns money each weekend catching and selling fish"))
assumptions: The stated earnings are saved toward the game, and the Sunday catch is sold at the stated per-fish amounts.
